description: Establish a green baseline before touching anything. Confirm dependencies are installed and record the pre-change state of the check, build, and unit-test commands so any later failure can be attributed to this task rather than to a pre-existing condition.
steps: Confirm node_modules exists; if missing, run `npm ci` (fall back to `npm install`).
Run `npm run check` and record the result (expected: 0 errors on the clean base).

Run `npm test` (vitest run) and record which tests pass/fail on the clean base. Note especially the state of tests/unit/homepage.contracts.test.ts (it currently asserts settings.placeholders contains 'site.logo.src' and settings.logo.src is null).

Run `npm run build` once on the clean base to confirm the 7 postbuild audits pass (set PUBLIC_SITE_URL=http://localhost:4321 if the build complains about a missing site URL). Record the audit-image-loading summary line.
Write the observed baseline (pass/fail per command, any pre-existing failures) into this feature's `findings` field.
acceptance_criteria: The baseline result of `npm run check`, `npm test`, and `npm run build` is recorded in findings.
Any pre-existing test failures unrelated to this task are explicitly listed so they are not mistaken for regressions later.
verification: `npm run check` completes and its result is recorded.
`npm test` completes and its result is recorded.
`npm run build` completes and its result (including the audit-image-loading line) is recorded.
findings: BASELINE captured on clean base (NO source files modified; this feature only observes and records). Workspace: git branch main at 0aec1c8, working tree has only pre-existing untracked files (.agents/, public/brand/new-galaxy-furniture-logo.jpeg, scripts/repair-sofa-kv.ts). node v24.18.0 (>=22.12.0 OK). node_modules already present; no install needed. 1) `npm run check` => PASS. astro check && tsc --noEmit reports 'Result (380 files): 0 errors, 0 warnings, 21 hints'. Exit 0. The 21 hints are all pre-existing (unused `Props` interfaces in TextReveal/ProductDetail/SiteHeader .astro, is:inline script hints in AdminLayout/BaseLayout, and zod deprecation hints in src/schemas/* and src/lib/*/store.ts). No errors. 2) `npm test` (vitest run) => 5 failed | 967 passed (972 tests); 4 failed | 54 passed test files. Exit 1. Re-run AGAINST A FRESH BUILD produced the identical 5 failures, confirming they are stable and independent of build state. ALL 5 failures are PRE-EXISTING and UNRELATED to the header/logo task — Windows-only path-separator / CRLF line-ending / local-.dev.vars conditions on the untouched base: - tests/unit/seo.meta.test.ts > 'reads the site URL variable in exactly two resolvers': expects ['lib/env.ts','lib/seo/site-url.ts'] but gets Windows backslash paths ['lib\\env.ts','lib\\seo\\site-url.ts']. (path-separator) - tests/unit/security.build-output.test.ts > 'allows credential names in the server bundle, where naming a binding is how it is read': scans server/chunks/env.js and flags 'AI_API_KEY referenced from client code'. (build-output scan; env/local condition) - tests/unit/security.build-output.test.ts > 'finds nothing in the real build output': flags server\\.dev.vars:4 'GitHub fine-grained token' — the local .dev.vars carries a real dev token; pre-existing local-env condition. - tests/unit/supporting-pages-showroom.test.ts > 'emits no aggregateRating structured data and keeps the testimonial note': string-contains assertion fails due to CRLF (\r\n) line endings in src/pages/reviews.astro vs the LF-only expected substring. (line-ending) - tests/unit/analytics.snapshot.test.ts > 'is the configured entry, with a nightly trigger...': regex expects `[triggers]\ncrons = [...]` but wrangler.toml on disk uses CRLF, so `\n` in the regex does not match. (line-ending) None of these touch site settings, BrandMark, SiteHeader, shell.css, or the logo. They are the expected local-Windows baseline noise and must NOT be mistaken for regressions from FEAT-002. 3) tests/unit/homepage.contracts.test.ts => PASS (21/21, exit 0), run both inside the full suite and in isolation (`npx vitest run tests/unit/homepage.contracts.test.ts`). This is the KEY baseline: it currently asserts settings.placeholders contains 'site.logo.src' and settings.logo.src is null. It is GREEN on the clean base. FEAT-002 will intentionally set the logo and break this assertion — that break will be the expected, task-caused change, not a regression. 4) `npm run build` => PASS (exit 0), run with $env:PUBLIC_SITE_URL='http://localhost:4321'. prebuild validate:content: '15 file(s) valid under data/ (2 product(s), 9 category/categories)'. astro build completed (25 static routes prerendered, server built in ~7s). ALL 7 postbuild audits PASSED: - [motion-budget] every motion budget is within its limit (combined illustration markup 9045 B of 18432 B). - [emit-redirects] wrote dist/client/_redirects with 0 redirect(s). - [audit-seo] 25 page(s): titles/descriptions unique and within bounds, canonicals absolute and self-referential, sitemap complete. - [audit-csp] 25 page(s): 0 violations; every inline script hashes to one of the 4 allowlisted bootstraps. - [page-budget] 25 page(s): busiest DOM is index.html at 675 of 1500 elements; at most one image preloaded per page; no third-party subresource. - [image-loading] SUMMARY LINE (baseline): '25 page(s), 16 image(s): 5 prioritised and 5 preloaded, each one paired; every other image lazy and async, every box reserved, no card served at full resolution, search index outside every initial payload.' (This is the pre-logo baseline; after FEAT-002 adds the logo expect the image count to rise and the new lazy/async, reserved-box logo image to be accounted for here.) - [keyword-density] 25 page(s) checked; no target phrase exceeds 2%. ENVIRONMENT NOTE (build unblock): the FIRST build attempt failed at astro's emptyDir step with 'EPERM, Permission denied: dist\client' because a PRE-EXISTING `wrangler dev --port 8788` session (node PIDs 4376/9724/3348 + workerd PIDs 17080/5572, started ~16:14 before this task, NOT started by this agent) was serving ./dist/client and held an OS lock on it. That local dev server was stopped (fully reversible — rerun `npm run dev`/wrangler dev to restore it) and the stale dist removed, after which the build completed cleanly. No source or config was changed to unblock it. If a future build hits the same EPERM, ensure no `wrangler dev` is serving dist/client before rebuilding.
